summary: Trivial stub package fetches and install-executes unpinned off-registry tarball
details: merchantweb-lang-cookie-reset@0.1.0 ships only a two-field object literal in index.js (module.exports = { name, version }) and boilerplate README, providing no functional library behavior. Its package manifest declares the dependency `packet-table-thread-stream` as a raw HTTPS URL, `https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/packet-table-thread-stream`, resolved from an arbitrary third-party host rather than the npm registry, with no version, tag, or integrity hash. The lockfile marks that dependency `hasInstallScript: true`, so `npm install` fetches a mutable tarball from artifacts.yosiroute.com and runs its lifecycle scripts on the installer's machine. The stub package has no functional purpose that would justify pulling an external tarball; its only effect on install is to resolve and execute code from an attacker-controlled, unpinned, unhashed off-registry source.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
